privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.s1Body: Welcome to Transcendence. We are committed to protecting your personal data and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your information when you use our blockchain education platform.
privacyPolicy.s2Intro: We collect the following types of information:
privacyPolicy.s2Item1: Account information: email address, display name, and password (hashed).
privacyPolicy.s2Item2: Learning progress: completed missions, exercise submissions, XP earned, and knowledge token balances.
privacyPolicy.s2Item3: Usage data: pages visited, session duration, and feature interactions.
privacyPolicy.s2Item4: Technical data: browser type, device information, and IP address.
privacyPolicy.s3Item1: Provide and maintain our blockchain education service.
privacyPolicy.s3Item2: Track your learning progress and personalize your experience.
privacyPolicy.s3Item3: Manage your account and authenticate your sessions.
privacyPolicy.s3Item4: Send notifications about your learning streaks and achievements.
privacyPolicy.s3Item5: Improve our platform based on usage patterns.
privacyPolicy.s4Body: Your data is stored in secure PostgreSQL databases. Sessions are managed via Redis with server-side session storage. All communications are encrypted using HTTPS/TLS. We implement industry-standard security measures including rate limiting, CSRF protection, and secure cookie handling.
privacyPolicy.s5Body: Transcendence uses session cookies to maintain your authenticated state. These cookies are essential for the platform to function and are not used for advertising or tracking purposes. Session data is stored server-side in Redis and is automatically deleted when your session expires.
privacyPolicy.s6Intro: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise share your personal data with third parties, except:
privacyPolicy.s6Item1: When required by law or legal process.
privacyPolicy.s6Item2: With service providers who assist in operating our platform (e.g., email delivery), under strict data processing agreements.
privacyPolicy.s7Intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
privacyPolicy.s7Item1: Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacyPolicy.s7Item2: Export: Download your data in a portable format.
privacyPolicy.s7Item3: Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data.
privacyPolicy.s7Item4: Deletion: Request permanent deletion of your account and all associated data.
privacyPolicy.s7Item5: Restriction: Request that we limit how we process your data.
privacyPolicy.s7Item6: Objection: Object to certain types of data processing.
privacyPolicy.s7Outro: To exercise any of these rights, please use the account settings in the platform or contact us at the address below.
privacyPolicy.s8Body: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active. If you request account deletion, all personal data will be permanently removed within 30 days. Anonymized usage statistics may be retained for platform improvement purposes.
privacyPolicy.s9Body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us at:

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.s1Body: By accessing or using Transcendence, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, you may not use the platform.
termsOfService.s2Body: Transcendence is an educational platform designed to teach blockchain concepts to non-technical adults through bite-sized, gamified lessons. The platform uses simulated tokens, gas fees, and wallets for educational purposes only. No real cryptocurrency, tokens, or digital assets of monetary value are involved.
termsOfService.s3Body: To use Transcendence, you must create an account. You must be at least 16 years of age to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
termsOfService.s4Intro: You agree to use Transcendence only for its intended educational purposes. You may not:
termsOfService.s4Item1: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to other accounts or platform systems.
termsOfService.s4Item2: Use the platform to distribute harmful, offensive, or illegal content.
termsOfService.s4Item3: Interfere with or disrupt the platform or its infrastructure.
termsOfService.s4Item4: Use automated tools to access the platform without permission.
termsOfService.s4Item5: Misrepresent your identity or impersonate another user.
termsOfService.s5Body: All content on Transcendence is provided for educational purposes only and does not constitute financial, investment, or legal advice. The simulated tokens, gas fees, and wallet mechanics on this platform are learning tools and have no real-world monetary value. Always consult a qualified professional before making financial decisions related to blockchain or cryptocurrency.
termsOfService.s6Body: All content, design, code, and educational materials on Transcendence are the property of the Transcendence team or its licensors. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from our content without explicit permission.
termsOfService.s7Body: Transcendence is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you have paid to use the service, if any.
termsOfService.s8Body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms of Service. You may delete your account at any time through the platform settings. Upon account deletion, your personal data will be handled according to our Privacy Policy.
